dimensions.detail: The skill’s stated purpose is keyword discovery, scoring, intent classification, and topic clustering; the artifact instructions and reference templates consistently support that SEO workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: There is a real scope mismatch: the description says competitor-relative coverage gaps should use another skill, while quick-start and advanced examples include competitor keyword-gap prompts. This is confusing but still within adjacent marketing research, not evidence of hidden or unsafe behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown skill and reference files only, with duplicated files matching by hash. No executable files, install hooks, or bundled scripts were present; static scan and VirusTotal telemetry were clean.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Optional SEO, Search Console, autocomplete, Firecrawl, and pageview data sources are proportionate for keyword research, but Search Console and SEO-tool data can expose private business analytics.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly says it writes reports under memory/research and promotes durable priorities to memory/hot-cache and memory/open-loops. That persistence is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but it lacks an explicit consent checkpoint in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: Accepted as a documentation/routing inconsistency: competitor-gap examples appear despite the manifest redirecting competitor-relative coverage gaps elsewhere. Downgraded because the behavior remains related to keyword research and does not add hidden authority.
[SDI-4] expected: Accepted as the same scope-confusion issue in the duplicate detailed instructions. It supports user caution, not a suspicious verdict by itself.
[SDI-1] expected: The broader advanced-usage section does include competitor-gap phrasing, but the rest of the workflow remains SEO keyword analysis with labeled metrics and no destructive or deceptive actions.
[SQP-2] expected: Accepted that durable memory writes are instructed without a separate consent step. Downgraded because the Skill Contract and Save Results section openly disclose the write paths and the stored content is directly related to the deliverable.
[SQP-1] expected: Broad trigger phrases such as content ideation and keyword questions are typical for this skill category. The artifact also includes a negative scope note for competitor-relative coverage gaps, though it is inconsistently applied.
[SQP-2] expected: The duplicate persistence finding is valid as user guidance: avoid running this on sensitive strategy data unless memory storage is acceptable.
llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the agent using any connected SEO or Search Console data for keyword research and saving summaries into the host memory files. For sensitive launches, private strategy, or client data, ask the agent not to persist results or manually review the generated memory entries afterward.
llm.summary: This appears to be a normal SEO keyword-research skill, but users should be aware it may use connected marketing data and save research summaries to memory.
